title: macOS Tahoe — Multi-Model Oneshot
approach: Full desktop built with multi-model orchestration (Kimi K2.7 orchestrator + MiniMax M3 subagents)
originalPrompt: Recreate the whole MacOs tahoe interface as a web app. Every app and menu should be working

questionsAndAnswers.question: Which macOS version should I target?
Which bundled apps must actually be interactive? Pick your top priorities.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Finder (files, windows, Dock, menus, drag/drop); Dock + Launchpad; System menu bar (Apple, status icons, Control Center, Spotlight); Safari (address bar, tabs, bookmarks, basic web view); Terminal (emulator + shell history, no real OS shell); Notes / Reminders / Calendar / Mail; Music / Photos / TV / Podcasts; System Settings (macOS-style preference panes); Calculator / Clock / Weather / Stocks / Maps
